The port's reps walk the poll phase over two poll periods (asm.py k_sb_while): the result ends on a poll about 25 pclk apart and the core repeats one phase every rep, so one fixed phase reads anywhere in 125.3..141.3 rclk; the phase mean is the busy time plus the mean poll delay.
